label: A pure favouring determination makes exactly the verdicts of its formal object
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every favouring profile phi, if the real determination that a favouring of the bearer is phi is a pure perfection (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION, the same purity parameter as the #2153 premises), then in every variation scenario phi favours x over y exactly when phi's formal object ranks x over y. The formal object is the ranking that measures phi's kind of operation (for a will, the good; for a natural tendency, the end of its nature), not phi's particular content; the Lean parameter does not enforce that, and with phi as its own object the bridge would be trivial. It is lane P's per-bearer reading of the loss and arbitrariness bridges taken together: a pure favouring neither misses nor adds a verdict of its own standard. It does not fix which standard that is, and it says nothing about whether the favouring is a natural or a rational appetite. With every favouring measured by value it is equivalent to the two value-sense bridges 720bccc2 and a141e6a8 together (Lean-only: valueBridgesArePerBearerConstant, with excluded middle, and perBearerConstantGivesValueBridges). Lane 2b's D-directed nature, measured by its own end, satisfies it.
